Come see for yourself why Time Out New York called the BBB, a completely unique experience... there isnt another band like this anywhere, and yelp.com proclaims, if you hear one band in NYC make sure this is it... and prepare to be blown away!

A Ghost in Your Ear

7:00 PM · Audible's Minetta Lane Theatre, Greenwich Village · ↻ Also on other days Going out

When an actor arrives late to a sound studio for a last-minute audiobook recording session, he is handed the script of a chilling ghost story to read. But as the engineer cues the recording and the evening wears on, the horrors slowly begin to escape the page to haunt the studio itself. Fresh from an acclaimed, sold-out run in London, A GHOST IN YOUR EAR is the "truly terrifying headphone horror" (The Guardian) from the darkly brilliant mind of Tony Award® nominee Jamie Armitage (SIX), made in collaboration with Ben and Max Ringham (ANNA, National Theatre). A mesmerizing blend of gothic horror and psychological thriller, this cutting-edge theatrical experience uses groundbreaking binaural sound technology to immerse every audience member in a haunting world of sound. And at Audible's Minetta Lane Theatre - one of New York's most intimate venues - there's no escaping the frights. Enter if you dare.

Irene Tu

7:00 PM · The Bell House, Carroll Gardens

Irene Tu is a LA-based stand-up comedian/actor/writer who honed her chops in San Francisco. Her 1st comedy album WE'RE DONE NOW debuted at #1 on the iTunes comedy charts. Paste mag praised the work, citing Irene's "quick wit, relaxed stage presence & hilariously off-the-wall observations." Among Netflix's "Introducing" comics of 2022, her show in 2024 was named 1 of the funniest by the LA Times. A regular at festivals & clubs across the US & she's opened for comics like Taylor Tomlinson, Ronny Chieng & Patton Oswalt. Online, her many clips have gone viral, amassing 30 million+ views across platforms. Door Time: 6pm (front bar opens: 5pm). Show Time: 7pm. 21 & over w/ valid, government-issued photo ID. General Admission standing & seating. *Seating 1st come 1st served & not guaranteed. Arrive early for best selection. **If you have an accessibility request, please email thebellhouse@livenation.com. ***No outside food/drink.

Troy Roberts Quartet - A Tribute to Stanley Turrentine

7:00 PM · Birdland Theater, Hell's Kitchen · $35.46 Something special

Tonight, Troy Roberts and his quartet comprised of some of the most in-demandmusicians on the scene, will celebrate the music of the tenor saxophone titan,Stanley Turrentine. Join us for an exclusive musical tip of the hat to one ofRoberts greatest saxophone influences, as this world-class quartet delves into thesoulful side of Jazz.Embracing his love for a vast variety of stylistic genres, three-time GRAMMYnominated saxophonist, Troy Roberts is quickly becoming one of the most widelyrecorded touring artists of his time. As a go-to first call saxophonist, his nameadorns several essential recordings ranging from the legendary Joey DeFrancesco,the iconic Van Morrison, the quintessential Jeff Tain Watts, the tireless OrrinEvans Captain Black Big Band, the critically acclaimed Kurt Elling, includingnumerous other jazz veterans, and newcomers considered tastemakers of theirgeneration.A prolific leader with sixteen releases to his name, the latest being Green Lights(featuring John Patitucci, Paul Bollenback and Jimmy Macbride), the New YorkCity based Australian immigrant maintains a busy recording and performanceschedule with his quartet, his original project Nu-Jive, as well as some of thegreatest artists of today.

-Please read fully to enjoy- BrownstoneJAZZ WEEKEND up close and personal. Intimate acoustic room live concerts Fridays & Saturdays 7:30pm or 9:30pm Sundays 4pm or 6pm Experience the JazzFest in a restored 19th Century Victorian Brownstone located in Bedford Stuyvesant's Central Brooklyn Landmarked Historical Community. Where you will feel transported back to an earlier time period walking through the doors. BrownstoneJAZZ Ensasmbles present the best of yesteryear's jazz soldiers and today's jazz frontier musicians, swinging with the authentic jazz style. Something for everyone to enjoy. Bed Stuy, B'klyn and SugarHill, Harlem were both Jazz Hey Day Communities. When Ella Fitzgerald lyricized the song 'TAKE THE A TRAIN' connecting NYC's two jazz hubs. BrownstoneJAZZ invites you to the magic of music with Curator Debbie McClain and M.C., Bassist Eric Lemons hosting you as you uncover this old school jazz venue to enjoy a different jazz experience. Get your ticket for our private event. Both Eric and Debbie have been involved in the world of music entertainment for years presenting major artist. The list is long. They really know their way around the business. FOR A LIMITED TIME: Tables and seats have been limited. Make early purchases. We sell out fast. NOTES DRESS TO IMPRESS --- It's the Jazz Age! Casual Classy, Cocktail or vintage attire are encouraged. Leave the jeans, shorts, t-shirt, and hoodie at home. NO Athletic Wear, Tank Tops, or T-shirts in THE ROOM NO REFUNDS (no exceptions) ID is required NO PETS NO Shopping-bags or Backpacks in THE ROOM.
